evidence.quoted_text: if (stream === null) throw new Error('missing classified artifact');
evidence.reason: `readStream` explicitly treats a missing `review.ndjson` as `null` (line 56), but `complete` hard-throws on that same value at line 86 before calling `completeLocalReview`. A terminated run with an exit artifact and no review stream therefore cannot reach the receipt/completion path; the adapter rejects the state instead of completing or recording a failed attempt. This is an implementation inconsistency in the existing completion flow.
